sourceRequirement: PDF page32: Show some bullet point instructions and a pop-up of terms and conditions to be agreed to become a partner before filling up this page.

acceptanceCriteria: Display accurate bullet point instructions for eligibility, application details, payout destination and Admin review before the application fields.
Show a Terms & Conditions popup with explicit unchecked agreement before any new application fields can be filled.
Cancel/dismiss must leave application fields inaccessible.
A stored own receipt for the current policy version avoids forcing an existing applicant to agree again.
Submission still requires the accepted terms flag and persists the existing server-side receipt atomically with the application.

before: Only a paragraph and bottom-of-form checkbox existed; fields could be filled before agreement. Existing saved acceptance was not loaded.
implemented: Bullet instructions and a blocking Terms popup; fields are not rendered until explicit agreement or a current-version own receipt. Not now/dismiss cannot bypass. Current-version receipt is read under existing own-user RLS. No backend policy or payout behavior changed.
localVerification: partner-preflight-test.mjs: executable actual component covers gate, unchecked disabled CTA, dismiss, explicit consent, saved acceptance, fail-closed retry and suspended accounts; actual Supabase SDK covers current/old/missing/unrecorded receipt and read error.
partner-submit-regression-test.mjs: real SDK payload validation, receiver, server error/retry and realtime lifecycle PASS.
productionVerification: Pending coordinated deployment and screenshot of the unaccepted popup. No legal agreement was accepted through browser automation.
